name: mcp.browser
rests_on: agents-browser CDP CLI (open/snapshot/click/type/...); commands discovered via --help-json, exit 0 = action ok

command.description: Declared command: open | snapshot | click | type | fill | select | scroll | tabs | find | wait | back | reload | close | headless | ...

argv.description: Full argv including the command (e.g. ["open", "https://..."]); wins over command when present
